title: Sideby — Pick your Mac workspace by its screens
description: Switch from development to planning across your Mac displays together. Save different window layouts on the same desktop, choose workspaces in a large visual gallery, and edit Space connections directly from the menu bar.
intro: Where's that screen? Connect the screens you use together and move to your next task in one action. Keep different window layouts on the same desktop, too.
film_alt: Sideby switches development and planning screens together across two displays and returns to a saved layout

benefit_title: Back to your task. In one move.
benefit_text: Code and docs. Plans and conversations. Keep the screens you use together in one connection, instead of finding them again on each display.

how_title: Keep the setup you have now.
how_intro: Arrange your windows and save once. One desktop can hold several saved layouts.
steps: Follow the guide for Accessibility and Screen Switching access. Choose Allow previews if you want screen thumbnails.
Hold ⌥⇧Space and click the center button. Save the current screens and supported window layouts as a new connection. Rename it later with the pencil button.
Click an image in the gallery to switch connected Spaces together, then restore the saved desktop window layout.
matrix_text: Hold ⌥⇧Space to open the gallery on the display under your pointer. Click an image to switch the connection; Bring forward changes only the preview order. Rename stays open for editing; Settings opens the shared settings window.
matrix_alt: Sideby gallery with large display previews and the central Add current screens button
matrix_note: Actual Sideby 1.3.0 UI with fictional connections and synthetic screens. No personal desktop was captured.
small_features: Save different positions and sizes for windows on one desktop. Connect more displays to switch their Spaces together.
A missing window does not stop you.
Closed or restarted windows are skipped. Available windows are restored where possible, with results reported.
Recent images are reused without continuous recording or timer-based capture. Visit an unseen desktop once to create its preview.
faqs: Connected Spaces and explicitly saved desktop layouts: window positions, sizes and the focused window. With previews allowed, a small image of that moment is kept on this Mac too. Saving the same desktop again creates a separate setup.
Does it reopen apps or restore every window?

After switching Spaces, it restores saved windows still available on the destination ordinary desktops. It does not reopen apps, documents or tabs, or pull windows out of another Space. Full-screen apps switch Spaces only. Layout restoration supports Stage Manager off and is subject to app size restrictions.
What if I disconnect a monitor?
Its connections are kept. Use Show disconnected displays to review them, then reconnect the monitor to use them again.
Apple silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. Public app downloads are temporarily paused.

Accessibility supports configured global input and window-layout restoration. Screen Switching access permits desktop transitions; some paths also need System Events Automation. Screen Recording is optional and requested through Allow previews.

Ordinary previews stay in memory; explicitly saved setup images and window information stay on your Mac. Disabling previews does not remove saved setup images. Images and typed input are not uploaded.
end_title: Back to your task. Screens and all.
end_text: Connect the screens you have now, then move to what is next.
editor_title: More room to see. Less effort to edit.
editor_text: Click Sideby in the menu bar to open Settings → Space connections. Expand the Space list to drag screens into connections. Press Esc or click the menu-bar icon again to close Settings.
editor_note: Edits are remembered immediately. Go together switches screens; Undo or ⌘Z restores edits. Existing connections start with the Space list collapsed.
editor_alt: Large connection editor with display previews, Show Space list and Go together controls
editor_overview: What if desktops or displays change?
editor_overview_text: Find new desktops in the upper list and connect them. If a desktop disappears, choose again in the affected cell. Sideby never replaces it with a different desktop at the same position. Disconnected displays keep their connections.

table_note: Drag within the same display's row to connect. Editing or dragging cells does not switch actual screens.
